name: GOV optional: outflow of one token from a liquidity holder
description: Outflow of one token from the address that holds it: the watched address, direction sent, netted per transaction, at least a minimum amount in raw token units. In an Aave V3 fork the funds sit in each reserve's aToken, not in the Pool: watch the aToken of every borrowable asset (Pool.getReserveData(asset).aTokenAddress), one alert per reserve. The address must be in the project. Send it to Slack or Email: the Web3 Action payload does not carry the matched transfers.
